summary: Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly business report in English for the period January-March 2026. The filing summarizes consolidated financial results, segment performance, and operational data with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine periodic report with no special-situation event triggering the filing.
